_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Material and Processing Digital Data Package (MPDDP)
summary: The MPDDP provides a means for transmitting contractor internal research and engineering materials data, generated per the SOW, in a format suitable for archiving, re-use, and re-distribution.
use_relationship:
The Material and Processing Digital Data Package (MPDDP) provides a means for transmitting contractor internal data which has been generated by the contractor in compliance with the work effort described in the Statement of Work (SOW). The MPDDP will be suitable for inclusion in a digital data repository in order to facilitate archiving, re-use, and re-distribution.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Material and Processing Digital Data Package (MPDDP) shall be encoded in a digital file format that is enduring, commonly accessible, and is both human interpretable and machine actionable.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The MPDDP shall convey internally generated research and engineering materials data and their accompanying metadata in a manner that maximizes reusability of the data. Each logical element of the MPDDP shall include the following data and metadata elements:

children.title: Summary metadata:
Elements as defined by ANSI/NISO Z39.85, The Dublin Core Metadata Element Set.
children.content: (Copies of this document are available online at http://www.niso.org/standards/).

children.title: Contract number.
Export control status.
For data acquired through experiment, characterization, or a manufacturing process:
Experimental, characterization, or manufacturing process results.
Pedigree and provenance of material.
Test apparatus, manufacturing/fabrication equipment, and their calibration including measurement and data collection method(s).
Testing standards or processing specifications used including sample preparation and/or manufacturing equipment configuration.
Experimental, characterization, or manufacturing processing conditions and procedures.
Data reduction and analysis procedures.
Uncertainty associated with the data and method used to calculate uncertainty.
For data created through simulation or design:
Simulation results.
Description of material state or process simulated.
Input variables, boundary conditions, and assumptions.
Computational environment.
Software name, publisher, and version number.
Data reduction and analysis procedures.
Uncertainty associated with the data and method used to calculate uncertainty.
Sensitivity analysis of results, if performed or appropriate.
Verification and validation procedures employed and the results.
